recipes.name: Creamy Cucumber Salad with Lemon Yogurt Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup mint leaves (, finely chopped (or 2 tsp dried mint))
1 cup yogurt (, full fat (Greek or plain))
instructions: Dressing: Mix ingredients then leave for 20 minutes for the flavours to develop.
Cucumber: Cut cucumber in half lengthwise, then slice into 3mm / 1/8" thick slices.
Toss: Place cucumber, onion and mint in a bowl. Pour over Dressing and toss, then serve.

page_recipe_notes: Recipe Notes: 1. Cucumber type – make this salad with 2 long cucumbers (Telegraph/English Cucumbers) or 3 medium standard cucumbers (called “Lebanese” cucumbers in Australia, these are the most common variety).
